sources.title: CD Projekt Red reassures players The Witcher 3 Switch 2 patch still due, as update rolls out for PS5 and PS5 Pro
sources.text: CD Projekt Red has released an update for The Witcher 3 Remastered on PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro , making "various stability improvements to help ensure a more reliable experience" to the game. And those are the entire patch notes for hotfix 5.01b , Eurogamer understands. The update has drawn some concern from players waiting for the promised Switch 2 Witcher 3 update , prompting the studio to reassure people on X that: "We're working on getting the Nintendo Switch 2 patch to all users as soon as possible." That Switch 2 patch is said to improve visual "clarity and sharpness" in the game. CD Projekt Red has been busy addressing issues with the Remastered edition of The Witcher 3 since it was released two weeks ago. It's a transformative update, significantly altering the game's visuals while also changing animations, skills, and even some gameplay. Given its breadth - and that it's free and occurring 11 years after the game's release - I called The Witcher 3 Remastered an extraordinarily generous upgrade after playing it , though the game's audience isn't entirely happy. Some feel it made the game too bright, though this aspect has been addressed in patches since release. Incidentally, Digital Foundry has now chimed into the performance discussion with a full appraisal of The Witcher 3 Remastered on PC , complete with optimised settings suggestions. DF is also tracking the various changes being made to path tracing in the game, which so far is enormously system-heavy. The Witcher 3 Remastered raises the game's visual standards ahead of the new Songs of the Past expansion arriving next year. This will bring a beautiful new region to explore, dozens of hours of gameplay, and a story revolving around Geralt's musical pal Dandelion and family. Dom had a chance to see Songs of the Past at Gamescom and came away impressed.

sources.title: New Oblivion Remastered Patch Fixes What The Old Oblivion Remastered Patch Broke On Switch 2
sources.text: Bethesda Patch Switch 2 The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered Last month, Bethesda pushed out a small update for the Switch 2 version of The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered. This patch ended up making the open-world RPG look a lot worse. ( Tale as old as time… ) Now, a new update is out for Oblivion on Switch 2 that, according to Bethesda, resolves the issue it introduced to the game the last time it updated the port. In late September, a small update arrived for Oblivion Remastered . Nobody was expecting much from the tiny update besides some minor bug fixes. However, players quickly began documenting numerous visual issues with the RPG post-patch, including ghosting and everything looking blurrier than before. Things were so bad that some players didn’t let their copy update to avoid the visual downgrade. But things should be better now. An update for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered on Nintendo Switch 2 has just released, resolving the global visual degradation issue discovered in the previous update. Thank you for your continued feedback and support! — Bethesda Game Studios (@BethesdaStudios) October 13, 2026 On October 13, Bethesda pushed out a new update for Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered on Switch 2 and confirmed that it had fixed a “global visual degradation issue discovered in the previous update.” According to players who have downloaded the new update , Oblivion on Switch 2 indeed looks much better and more like it did before September’s patch borked everything up. Some are even suggesting it might be running a bit better than it ever did. Interesting. The patch is also reportedly bigger than some expected, making me wonder what Bethesda did in the first place to cause the visual issues. Regardless, it is now safe to download the latest patch for Oblivion on Switch 2. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. sources.name: Polygon
sources.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Switch 2 Patch Is Officially 'On the Way'
sources.text: Switch 2 players won't have to wait too long for their patch All platforms except the Nintendo Switch 2 have received fixes for The Witcher 3 following the launch of the remastered version on Sept. 29. Fans have appreciated developer CD Projekt Red's commitment to make this free update to their award-winning game meet fans' expectations, but it seems that Switch 2 users had been left behind. Thankfully, the developers have given some insight into the highly anticipated Switch 2 update. On Oct. 9, CD Projekt Red released patch 5.01 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered . It included much-needed changes and fixes, such as improved performance and bloom, and additional visual customization options. While the update significantly improved the state of the game, it was exclusive to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, which meant Switch 2 players were stuck with any problems caused by the remastered patch. In the patch notes, CD Projekt Red assured fans that it was still working on a patch for the Switch 2, and that new information would be coming soon. Another patch rolled out for The Witcher 3 Remastered on Oct. 13. It was a small hotfix that increased stability and provided a better gameplay experience for players on PlayStation 5. Once again, Switch 2 players sat by as other platforms were prioritized. It wasn't surprising when CD Projekt Red announced the PS5 hotfix on social media, and the comments were flooded with unhappy Switch 2 players — especially considering that there are now more Witcher 3 players on Switch 2 thanks to the game duplication exploit affecting cartridge owners. CD Projekt Red was quick to reply to the disgruntled fans, letting them know that the update is "on the way" and that it "should have more information for those playing on Nintendo Switch 2 very soon." This was a relief for many, as it reassured them that they wouldn't have to wait much longer to enjoy the game in a better state. According to the v5.01 patch notes , the Switch 2 update will include all the improvements made to other platforms and fix Switch-specific issues regarding image clarity and sharpness.

stories.title: Sifu será lançado para Android e iOS em outubro; veja trailer do port

sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Sifu será lançado para Android e iOS em outubro; veja trailer do port
sources.text: Sifu , jogo de artes marciais da Sloclap, será lançado para Android e iOS. A desenvolvedora anunciou a versão mobile do game, com estreia prevista para 12 de outubro deste ano. “A mesma ação, a mesma aura, a mesma atmosfera. Agora, na palma da sua mão”, anunciou a Sloclap no X. Na mesma publicação, a empresa anexou um trailer de gameplay da nova versão. A jogatina de Sifu no mobile parece ser idêntica à versão para PC e consoles, com os mesmos cenários, personagens e chefões – portanto, tudo indica que seja um port. No vídeo, são exibidos os botões virtuais adaptados para a tela touchscreen, que permitirão experimentar a porradaria mesmo sem um controle dedicado . Sifu é um jogo de artes marciais com combate rápido, em que o jogador acompanha o protagonista em uma jornada de vingança. O combate é cheio de combos interessantes e marcado pelo forte foco em parries e desvios. Porém, o que deixou Sifu mais relevante é o sistema de vidas. Durante as fases, cada morte do personagem principal não é necessariamente fatal, mas faz com que ele envelheça alguns anos – o que o deixa mais forte com o tempo, mas também mais frágil. O game over acontece quando o protagonista fica velho demais para retornar após uma derrota. Reconhecido jogo de artes marciais da Sloclap, Sifu foi lançado para PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 e PC em fevereiro de 2022; chegou ao Nintendo Switch meses depois e, em 2023, foi lançado para Xbox One e Xbox Series X | S. O jogo já está listado na App Store e na Play Store. No iOS, vai custar US$ 7,99 (R$ 39,80, em conversão direta) ; no Android, o preço ainda não aparece na loja, mas já é possível fazer o pré-registro, que notifica o usuário quando o jogo estiver pronto para download. O jogo conquistou uma boa nota na análise do Voxl anos atrás . Ao longo do tempo, muito conteúdo foi adicionado ao game, incluindo novas arenas, cosméticos desbloqueáveis e mais desafios que estendem as horas de conteúdo. Quer ficar por dentro das novidades do mundo dos games? Acesse o Voxl e acompanhe as últimas notícias sobre Sifu , jogos mobile e lançamentos. sources.title: REPLACED coming to Android on December 8
sources.text: Publisher Atari and developer Sad Cat Studios will release atmospheric narrative-driven cyberpunk adventure game REPLACED for Android via Google Play on December 8, the companies announced. REPLACED first launched for Xbox Series and PC via Steam , Epic Games Store , Microsoft Store , and GOG on April 14. It is also available via Game Pass. Here is an overview of the game, via Atari: The mobile version is part of the Google Play Games program, offering seamless gaming across mobile, tablets, and PC via a single purchase. The Android version, ported by Poland-based studio The Knights of U, will allow a new audience to experience the same jaw-dropping cinematic visuals and immersive atmosphere that those players loved on its original PC and console release. REPLACED has been played by over 900,000 players across all platforms since its release in Spring 2026. REPLACED is a narrative-driven 2.5D platformer blending cinematic exploration with fluid, free-flow action. Immerse yourself in an alternate 1980s America reshaped by nuclear catastrophe and meet the downtrodden of Phoenix City as you struggle to survive. Soak up the game’s rich atmosphere as you walk the streets of Phoenix-City and become a part of the stories of the citizens you meet in this dark cyberpunk thriller. As you uncover the sinister secrets of Phoenix Corporation, REPLACED explores themes of humanity, identity, and control through morally complex characters and the slow reveal of a world pushed to its limits. Discover a haven for corruption where outlaws thrive and human life is traded like currency as R.E.A.C.H.—an AI trapped in a human body against its will. Expose the Corporation’s hidden agenda, and uncover the purpose behind your creation in a world where every secret—and every life—has a price.

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: ConcernedApe Teases More Action-RPG Gameplay In Haunted Chocolatier: ‘It’s For The People In Stardew Valley That Go Into The Mines’
sources.text: Action-RPG Haunted Chocolatier Stardew Valley Stardew Valleyâs mines have always been pretty polarizing. Some players love to grind them for endless challenge runs and min-maxing, while die-hard cozy gamers have sworn off them entirely, pledging to stick to farming and fishing and avoiding combat as much as possible. Thanks to a new interview, it now sounds like that former camp will be in luck whenever Haunted Chocolatier , the upcoming game from Stardew developer Eric âConcernedApeâ Barone, launches. In an interview with British GQ , Barone revealed that Haunted Chocolatier âis more of an action RPGâthe main focus is more about adventuring, finding equipment and getting more powerful. There are monsters, there are boss fights. It’s for the people in Stardew Valley that go into the mines.â Barone clarified that itâll still be what he refers to as a âtown game,â though, likely meaning itâll still revolve around the experience of settling into a new town and getting to know your neighbors as you build up your business. We already knew that Haunted Chocolatier was bound to have in-depth combatâearlier peeks at the game have shown off bosses, enemy-stunning shields, and other off-hand weapons. The game is also slated to have slightly darker themes, and now that Barone has cited David Lynch as an inspiration as well, Iâd count on things being a bit surreal. While speaking to GQ , Barone also briefly touched on the pressure heâs been facing to develop Haunted Chocolatier , which has been in the works for over four years now (that’s almost the same amount of time that Stardew was in development before its release). Barone has yet to announce a release window, likely because the game is set to be âway biggerâ than its predecessorâ¦somehow. âEveryone’s watching me, and if I don’t do things a certain way, it might disappoint millions of people,â he said. Iâm certainly willing to wait as long as Haunted Chocolatier might take to wrap, especially now that I know Iâll have plenty of combat to sink my sweet tooth into. The mines are probably my favorite part of Stardew (although they were definitely an acquired taste). They get pretty repetitive after a while, though, so Iâm excited to see what else Barone does to keep the action fresh in Haunted Chocolatier . Let’s just hope that those terrible spiral-shaped floors don’t make a return. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. stories.title: 5 jogos exclusivos de PS5 que você não pode perder
stories.summary: Astro Bot, Demon’s Souls, Ghost of Yōtei e outros títulos mostram algumas das experiências que continuam associadas ao console da Sony O post 5 jogos exclusivos de PS5 que você não pode perder apareceu primeiro em Olhar Digital .

sources.name: Olhar Digital Games
sources.title: 5 jogos exclusivos de PS5 que você não pode perder
sources.text: Com cada vez mais jogos da PlayStation chegando ao PC, falar em “exclusivos de PS5” ficou um pouco mais complicado. Títulos como Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 , God of War Ragnarök e Horizon Forbidden West , por exemplo, já podem ser encontrados fora do console. Ainda assim, o PS5 mantém jogos que permanecem ligados à plataforma e ajudam a mostrar diferentes lados do catálogo da Sony . De plataformas a RPGs difíceis, passando por grandes aventuras de mundo aberto, separamos cinco títulos para conhecer. Depois de Astro’s Playroom apresentar gratuitamente algumas das possibilidades do DualSense, Astro Bot transformou a ideia em uma aventura completa. O jogo de plataforma coloca o pequeno robô da PlayStation em dezenas de fases, com mecânicas que mudam constantemente e referências a diferentes momentos da história dos consoles da Sony. O destaque está justamente na variedade. Cada mundo apresenta ideias próprias, enquanto recursos como resposta tátil e gatilhos adaptáveis são incorporados à jogabilidade. Para quem acabou de comprar um PS5, é uma das melhores portas de entrada para entender o que o hardware pode oferecer além de gráficos melhores. O remake de Demon’s Souls , desenvolvido pela Bluepoint Games, reconstruiu o RPG lançado originalmente para PS3 e ajudou a apresentar o potencial técnico do PS5 logo no início da geração. A estrutura, porém, continua bastante fiel ao original. O jogador precisa explorar áreas perigosas, enfrentar inimigos capazes de puni-lo rapidamente e aprender com cada derrota. É uma experiência exigente, mas que recompensa observação, paciência e domínio dos sistemas de combate. Também é uma boa escolha para entender as raízes da fórmula que posteriormente ajudaria a popularizar jogos como Dark Souls e Elden Ring . Ghost of Yōtei leva a fórmula apresentada em Ghost of Tsushima para uma nova história, ambientação e protagonista. Desta vez, acompanhamos Atsu em uma jornada pelo Japão do século XVII, com exploração, confrontos e uma narrativa de vingança no centro da experiência. Um ano após o lançamento, o game também ganhou uma Edição Completa, reunindo a campanha principal, o multiplayer Legends , o modo roguelike Mais Procurados e a expansão narrativa Ecos de Sekigahara . Para quem procura uma aventura extensa no PS5, é uma das opções mais completas atualmente. A Insomniac Games trocou o Homem-Aranha por outro herói da Marvel em Marvel’s Wolverine . O jogo acompanha Logan em uma aventura mais violenta e coloca as famosas garras do personagem no centro de um sistema de combate pensado para transmitir sua força e agressividade. O título também funciona como uma das grandes vitrines da geração do PS5. Para quem gostou do trabalho da Insomniac com Marvel’s Spider-Man , Wolverine é uma escolha natural, mas com identidade própria e uma proposta de combate bem diferente das aventuras de Peter Parker e Miles Morales. James Bond também ganhou uma nova interpretação nos videogames com 007 First Light . Desenvolvido pela IO Interactive, de Hitman , o título apresenta uma versão mais jovem do agente antes de se tornar o famoso 007. A proposta combina espionagem, infiltração, ação e diferentes maneiras de resolver situações, aproveitando a experiência do estúdio com ambientes que oferecem múltiplas possibilidades ao jogador. Para quem gosta de jogos de espionagem, é uma alternativa que foge um pouco dos tradicionais mundos abertos e aventuras de super-heróis. A estratégia da Sony mudou ao longo dos últimos anos, e exclusividade passou a ser um conceito menos definitivo. Jogos que começam restritos ao PlayStation podem posteriormente receber versões para outras plataformas, especialmente PC. Por isso, mais importante do que montar uma biblioteca pensando apenas no selo de “exclusivo” é observar quais experiências fazem sentido para quem tem o console. Astro Bot , Demon’s Souls , Ghost of Yōtei , Marvel’s Wolverine e 007 First Light representam gêneros bastante diferentes e ajudam a mostrar a variedade disponível no PS5. sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Loja pirata traz mais de 1 mil jogos grátis para o PS5 em versão desbloqueada, mas pode dar ban
sources.text: Um novo aplicativo chamado Overdrive foi lançado recentemente para o PlayStation 5 desbloqueado e permite baixar jogos e conteúdos adicionais (DLCs) sem custos. A ferramenta funciona como uma loja digital alternativa para consoles que passaram pelo processo de desbloqueio, violando diretrizes da PlayStation Store. A novidade surge em meio a relatos sobre novas possibilidades abertas pelo jailbreak do PS5. Nas últimas semanas, usuários também demonstraram recursos como a execução de discos de PlayStation 2 no console atual . Vídeos publicados recentemente nas redes sociais mostram o funcionamento do Overdrive e uma biblioteca com mais de mil jogos. Como a ferramenta está associada à pirataria, certamente que os downloads não estão autorizados pelas detentoras dos direitos dos títulos. O Overdrive funciona como uma loja instalada diretamente no PS5 desbloqueado. Por meio da interface, os usuários podem navegar pelo catálogo e selecionar jogos para baixar, sem que a listagem apresente preços. Em vez dos valores normalmente exibidos nas lojas digitais oficiais, a interface mostra informações como o tamanho dos arquivos e a classificação indicativa dos títulos. O aplicativo, portanto, oferece uma experiência semelhante à de uma loja convencional, mas voltada à distribuição não autorizada de jogos. Entre os jogos exibidos nos vídeos estão Battlefield 6 , 007: First Light , Forza Horizon 5 e Black Myth: Wukong . Apesar da quantidade de jogos disponíveis, o funcionamento do Overdrive depende de um console compatível com o desbloqueio. A instalação também não representa uma alternativa oficial à PlayStation Store, e o download de jogos protegidos por direitos autorais sem autorização pode configurar violação de propriedade intelectual. Ou seja, assim como desbloquear o PS5, baixar a loja pode gerar banimento da conta da PSN e do console. Além da distribuição de jogos, o PS5 desbloqueado também recebeu uma ferramenta relacionada ao Xbox Cloud Gaming, serviço de jogos em nuvem da Microsoft. Segundo uma reportagem do WccfTech , o cliente nativo se chama PSXBOX e permite acessar e transmitir títulos no console da Sony. A ferramenta oferece streaming em resolução de até 1080p a 60 quadros por segundo. O cliente também é compatível com o controle DualSense, permitindo utilizar os recursos do acessório durante as partidas. O PSXBOX inclui ainda um menu acessível durante os jogos, com estatísticas e configurações de imagem, resolução de transmissão e opções de upscaling. O funcionamento depende do desbloqueio do console e do acesso ao serviço de jogos em nuvem. O desbloqueio do PlayStation 5 também vem abrindo espaço para projetos de emulação. Entre eles está o PS5CEMU-HAR, ferramenta que adapta emuladores de Wii U e Nintendo 3DS ao console da Sony e permite executar The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild em 4K a 30 FPS . O projeto reúne os emuladores Cemu, voltado a jogos de Wii U, e Azahar, destinado a títulos de Nintendo 3DS. A renderização utiliza a API gráfica Vulkan por meio de uma versão do driver RADV adaptada para o PS5, com suporte ao DualSense. Segundo a descrição do projeto, a ferramenta integra os dois emuladores em uma estrutura própria. “Ele reúne dois emuladores, ambos renderizando com Vulkan através da versão para PS5 do driver RADV feita por Mihawk e executados com o DualSense”, afirma a documentação. No caso do Cemu, o sistema também oferece recursos como renderização em 3840 x 2160, filtros de upscaling, suporte a telas de 120 Hz e pacotes gráficos criados pela comunidade. A compatibilidade e o desempenho variam conforme o jogo e a versão do sistema utilizada. Vale ressaltar que a Sony já corrigiu o exploit que permite desbloquear o PS5 usando o método Relapse, que permite o uso de lojas como o Overdrive e emulação de jogos. No entanto, a solução ainda roda em consoles que não tiveram o firmware atualizado. Ainda assim, para o usuário comum, a dica é ficar longe de soluções como essa, que podem render banimento e até inutilizar o console. O VOXL também ressalta que é contra toda forma de pirataria de games e aconselha jogadores a evitarem processos que podem render violações de direitos autorais. Você acha que o desbloqueio do PS5 e a facilidade de acessar jogos piratas podem mudar o cenário do console? Conte sua opinião nas redes sociais do Voxl ! stories.title: Epic Games reportedly delays Star Wars and Marvel shooter, as the Fortnite maker embraces "AI-accelerated development"
stories.summary: Epic Games has reportedly turned to gen-AI to finish up development on a shooter that crosses over Star Wars and Marvel, which has been internally delayed. Read more

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Epic Games reportedly delays Star Wars and Marvel shooter, as the Fortnite maker embraces "AI-accelerated development"
sources.text: Epic Games has reportedly turned to gen-AI to finish up development on a shooter that crosses over Star Wars and Marvel, which has been internally delayed. That's according to a Bloomberg report from journalist Jason Schreier, citing anonymous sources familiar with the unannounced game. Epic's in-development project - a collaboration with Disney - is said to have hit a speed bump, and the Fortnite maker is apparently telling its developers to embrace more gen-AI tools for the rest of the game's production. The new shooter purportedly features characters from both the Marvel and Star Wars series, and the company expected to have it out the door in March 2027. Now that the crossover project has slipped, Epic reportedly told its staff to adopt an "AI first" production pipeline and finish the game with tech such as Anthropic's Claude. In an internal message seen by Bloomberg, one game director told developers there would be "no more hand-written code" and art work should be "generated with full AI workflows" - much to the surprise of many workers. "We're embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do," Epic's communications director, Jake Jones, said in a statement to Bloomberg. "We have a huge pivot underway here at Epic, moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration," CEO Tim Sweeney tweeted . "The aim isn't to do the same stuff with fewer people, but to enable everyone here to build MORE and BETTER stuff, and to bring the benefits to all teams using Unreal." The Walt Disney company acquired a $1.5b stake in Epic Games a few years back, as the two entertainment giants agreed to partner on a "games and entertainment universe" somehow connected to Fortnite. There weren't any concrete details on the collaboration at the time, though the duo said players would be able to "create their own stories and experiences, express their fandom in a distinctly Disney way, and share content with each other in ways that they love". More recently, it was reported that senior Disney executives were interested in buying Epic Games outright . Epic's push for gen-AI to infiltrate almost all levels of game development comes less than a year after it laid off over 1,000 humans . At the time, CEO Tim Sweeney told staff "we're spending significantly more than we're making, and we have to make major cuts to keep the company funded."

sources.name: The Verge Games
sources.title: Epic shifts to ‘AI-accelerated development’ for upcoming Disney game
sources.text: Developers working on the unannounced shooter game were told to use AI tools like Anthropic’s Claude.﻿ Developers working on the unannounced shooter game were told to use AI tools like Anthropic’s Claude.﻿ Epic Games plans to use AI to generate code and art for an unannounced Disney game, which is now delayed from its original March release window, according to a report from Bloomberg . The project’s developers have been given an “AI-first” mandate directing them to use tools like Anthropic’s Claude more to finish the game. According to Bloomberg , one of the game’s directors said in a message to staff, “No more hand-written code.” Staff were also told that all of the game’s art will be “generated with full AI workflows.” In a statement given to Bloomberg , Epic Games spokesperson Jake Jones said the company is “embracing AI-accelerated development.” Epic Games and Disney did not immediately respond to a request for comment, but Epic CEO Tim Sweeney tweeted : “We have a huge pivot underway here at Epic, moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration. The aim isn’t to do the same stuff with fewer people, but to enable everyone here to build MORE and BETTER stuff, and to bring the benefits to all teams using Unreal.” The upcoming game is reportedly a shooter featuring characters from Marvel and Star Wars . It’s part of a multiyear collaboration between Epic and Disney, which also invested $1.5 billion in Epic in 2024. Epic already uses AI in Fortnite , which has previously featured Disney characters like an AI Darth Vader . But it sounds like Epic may be aiming to have AI do most of the heavy lifting on its new Disney game. AI game development tools have been popping up from other large companies, like Meta and Google , so Epic isn’t alone here. Epic CEO Tim Sweeney has also pushed for Steam to drop its “made with AI” tag , arguing that “AI will be involved in nearly all future production.” Earlier this year, Epic laid off over 1,000 of its employees , following a “downturn” in engagement on Fortnite since 2025. Update, October 13th: Added Sweeney’s tweet.

stories.title: "I was forced to ship the game" - Glen Schofield blames Krafton management for The Callisto Protocol's problems
stories.summary: Glen Schofield, the game-maker best known for co-creating Dead Space, has blamed Korean company Krafton - the owner of PUBG - for the shortcomings of his horror game successor The Callisto Protocol , which it published. Read more

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: "I was forced to ship the game" - Glen Schofield blames Krafton management for The Callisto Protocol's problems
sources.text: "A lot of them were caused by Korean management." Glen Schofield, the game-maker best known for co-creating Dead Space, has blamed Korean company Krafton - the owner of PUBG - for the shortcomings of his horror game successor The Callisto Protocol , which it published. In an interview with GamesIndustry.biz , Schofield expressed frustrated bewilderment at Krafton's handling of his Striking Distance company, which it had invested in, during the Covid pandemic. Krafton allegedly promised Striking Distance three extra months of development time and then rescinded it. "I was forced to ship the game," Schofield said. "I'm mad at myself, there's no doubt. I was so stunned by that decision, because we had fucking Covid. A million people died in America. I lost one of my best friends. "Every single month, four to six people in my company were getting sick. There were times [when] our small team in Spain was shut down; it goes through a small place like that and you lose your rendering team for a while. "The main thing you're concerned about, not that you aren't normally, is the health of your team. Making a game just became secondary because this is about life. This is about humanity." Schofield has discussed the decision to deny the three extra months of development time before . Had it not, then The Callisto Protocol would have been released in March 2023, rather than December 2022. This sudden rug-pull had also come after years of the studio adapting to working during a pandemic already, which Schofield said had been very hard to do. "When you have a studio of a hundred people, you can touch a hundred people a day. When they're at home, you have to do individual calls, or I could get everybody together on Zoom," said Schofield. "But we did it. We did all these things because we were searching for the best way to do it. There were so many meetings. "We had to learn on the job and just change everything," he added. "We got it done and everything. We saw the problems that we had. A lot of them were caused by Korean management." Before it was embroiled in a legal battle with Subnautica 2 creators , Krafton was mostly known as the PUBG company. Having found so much success with the battle royale shooter and its off-shoots, the publisher was ready to invest in the triple-A space - but it seemingly wasn't ready for that new role. Schofield said Krafton lacked the necessary experience to release a single-player physical game, forcing Striking Distance to build an internal team to do that. Krafton also allegedly mandated a release of The Callisto Protocol on PlayStation 4 alongside PS5, which would cost "another $20 million", Schofield said, and require sending out 200 dev kits to developers during a global chip shortage. None of that helped The Callisto Protocol's fortunes, and Krafton wasn't happy with its financial performance as a result. "[Krafton] thought Callisto was a complete failure," Schofield revealed. "What they didn't know while all they were doing was complaining, we were doing patches. I waited until I finished all the DLC and put out 86 patches. That was a lot of fucking work. Every day you're going in, you're making changes. Some are little, others are massive. That was all to get it back to where it needed to be." The Callisto Protocol received a mixed reception at launch, owing to technical and performance issues but also to core design elements relating to combat. In the Eurogamer review of The Callisto Protocol , Vikki Blake praised the game's production values but lamented its lack of depth and tension compared to Dead Space.

stories.title: Casual game store Legacy Games is shutting down, purchases won’t be re-downloadable despite ‘keep forever’ slogan
stories.summary: After February 2027, players will no longer be able to download or install purchased games

sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: Casual game store Legacy Games is shutting down, purchases won’t be re-downloadable despite ‘keep forever’ slogan
sources.text: After February 2027, players will no longer be able to download or install purchased games Casual games publisher Legacy Games has announced that its online store is closing down, and players won’t be able to re-download their purchases. Legacy Games was founded in 1998 and has specialised in publishing casual and indie titles on PC , console and mobile. In 2020 the publisher launched the Legacy Games online store , which to date offers more than 1,000 titles, many of which are released in multi-game bundles and mostly consist of hidden object, match 3, time management and puzzle games. The website’s slogan, which is still top of the homepage at the time of writing, is “amazing games, incredible value, yours to keep forever”. It appears the latter claim will no longer be true, however, as Legacy Games has announced its site is closing down, and previous purchases will no longer be downloadable after a certain point. The store will close on December 31, 2026. Players who bought physical Legacy Games titles which come with download codes will have to redeem them by then, or they will longer work. After the store closes, players will be able to continue downloading their previous purchases to the Legacy Games Launcher and play them as normal, but won’t be able to buy any new games. From February 28, 2027, however, players will also no longer be able to re-download their previous purchases, meaning they’ll be locked out of installing them on other devices in the future. Legacy Games says that any games downloaded and installed before the February 28, 2027 deadline will remain playable after this date, for as long as they remain installed on that device. Once they’re deleted, however, they can’t be redownloaded. This also applies to the free Legacy Games titles that have been available to claim via Amazon Prime’s monthly PC game offers. Players who have claimed these games in the past will have until February 28, 2027 to download these too. Legacy Games claims that because players can continue to play installed games after February 28, 2027 this means “your games stay yours”, and installing them is “how to keep them”. Given that people generally don’t keep the same PC or laptop for the rest of their lives however, when they eventually upgrade to a new device their games won’t be able to come with them.

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Online Store That Promised Games Were ‘Yours To Keep Forever’ Is Shutting Down
sources.text: Legacy Games is a clearinghouse for all sorts of games you probably haven’t heard of. The online storefront and launcher provides deals on bundles of lesser-known indie and casual games that people can download for cheap. “Get up to 15 games in a single pack,” reads the marketing copy on the home page. “Hidden object, match 3, puzzles and more! Starting at $14.99. No subscription needed.” Over 1 million customers have been served. In the biggest, boldest letters of all, the site states, “Amazing games. Incredible value. Yours to keep forever.” There should now be an asterisk next to “forever” that says, “if you download them before February 28, 2027.” That’s when the Legacy Games online storefront is shutting down for good. As VGC reports , the announcement was made on the site’s FAQ page this week. Game-of-the-month deals will end on December 1. Disc download codes, which the company also sells, will no longer work after December 31. Everything else goes offline on February 28, 2027. That’s the last day for people who have claimed games but potentially uninstalled them to re-download them and keep them forever before they’re gone forever. “Download and install your purchased games through the Legacy Games Launcher as soon as you can, and no later than February 28, 2027,” the FAQ reads . “Once theyâre installed, you can play them through the launcher any time. We recommend installing everything you want to keep while you still can.” All of users’ existing points, rewards, and membership perks will expire at the end of the year as well. Legacy Games also had a partnership with Amazon’s Luna streaming service. Anything there will also still be supported, but only if it’s been claimed prior to the end date. “Oh yes, I have infinite storage available,” wrote one person on the Prime Gaming subreddit. “This is shitty business practice and we need more laws to avoid such behavior or have some compensation to the users.” Another person chimed in, “Bruh I hope GOG doesn’t end like this.” While it’s harder to imagine the bigger digital game storefronts going bust, especially GOG and Steam, nothing actually lasts forever, especially in digital form, no matter what the marketing tagline on the website is. At least in the case of digital PC games sold without DRM, players can shift them around between their own storage devices without having to worry about launchers or redownloading them. It’s still a pain and not the way most people have been trained to think of their digital game libraries, which is instead as something that will magically outlast the crumbling physical world around it. Not so in the case of Legacy Games. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. especial_gta6.tema: Trailer 1 de GTA 6 (dezembro de 2023): o que mostrou e os recordes que quebrou
especial_gta6.angulo: Relembrar, a pouco mais de um mês do lançamento, o vídeo que apresentou Lucia, Vice City e o estado de Leonida ao mundo e virou recorde no YouTube, inclusive para quem acompanhou tudo de madrugada no Brasil.

fatos.texto: Em 8 de novembro de 2023, Sam Houser, presidente e fundador da Rockstar Games, anunciou no X que a empresa lançaria no início de dezembro o primeiro trailer do 'próximo Grand Theft Auto'.
O anúncio veio ligado aos 25 anos da Rockstar, fundada em 1998 e que completava aniversário em dezembro de 2023.

A estreia oficial do trailer estava marcada para terça-feira, 5 de dezembro de 2023, mas uma versão vazou na noite anterior (4 de dezembro) e a Rockstar antecipou a publicação do vídeo oficial no YouTube.
Ao antecipar o trailer, a Rockstar escreveu no X: 'Nosso trailer vazou, então, por favor, assistam ao verdadeiro no YouTube'.

Junto com o trailer, a Rockstar e a Take-Two confirmaram em comunicado de 4 de dezembro de 2023 que Grand Theft Auto VI sairia em 2025 para PlayStation 5 e Xbox Series X|S (essa data depois foi adiada duas vezes, até 19 de novembro de 2026).
O comunicado oficial situou o jogo em Leonida, estado fictício que inclui Vice City; o GameSpot descreveu Leonida como a versão da Rockstar para a Flórida.
Sam Houser declarou no comunicado do trailer que a Rockstar estava empolgada por poder compartilhar 'essa nova visão com jogadores do mundo todo'.
O trailer apresentou Lucia, a primeira protagonista mulher da série, segundo CNN e The Guardian.
Lucia aparece de uniforme de presidiária sendo interrogada, e o vídeo indica uma dupla de protagonistas (um homem e uma mulher) no estilo Bonnie e Clyde.

Entre as cenas do trailer estão aerobarcos nas áreas alagadas, vídeos que imitam redes sociais, imagens de câmera corporal da polícia, o noticiário Weazel News cobrindo perseguições e uma dupla mascarada assaltando uma loja de conveniência.
A música do trailer é 'Love Is a Long Road', de Tom Petty; o Spotify registrou alta de 36.979% nos streams da faixa em relação à semana anterior.
Segundo o Guinness World Records, o trailer teve 90.421.491 visualizações no YouTube nas primeiras 24 horas, recorde de revelação de videogame mais vista na plataforma nesse período.
O Guinness também reconheceu os cerca de 8,9 milhões de curtidas em 24 horas como recorde de trailer de videogame mais curtido no YouTube.
O vídeo virou ainda o conteúdo não musical mais visto do YouTube em 24 horas, superando o recorde anterior, que era de um vídeo do MrBeast.
Há divergência sobre o número do primeiro dia: o Guinness registra cerca de 90,4 milhões de visualizações, enquanto VGC e TechRadar citam 93 milhões no primeiro dia.
Até maio de 2025, cerca de 17 meses depois, o primeiro trailer somava aproximadamente 255 milhões de visualizações no YouTube.
O primeiro trailer foi publicado só no YouTube, o que o diferencia do segundo, lançado em várias plataformas ao mesmo tempo em maio de 2025.
